protocol.directClick: No hover or preparation intent; Command-click dispatched to the actual source Session row. A target already preparing is rejected.
protocol.source: Synthetic Session already open in source; optional neutral warm spare initialized for at least 1500 ms.
protocol.comparison: Pre-merge runs: Long: after then before, 10 samples each. Short: before then after, 5 each. Each run discards three warmups. Same CLI, dependencies and probe; no CPU profiling, native override, concurrent build or test.
protocol.input: Unique webContents.insertText token retained after a frame; includes focus and verification IPC, excludes physical keyboard, IME and display scanout.
protocol.retarget: Separate regression: neighbor deliberately prepared, then target requested with zero lead; not a strict neutral direct-click sample.
protocol.limits: Small sequential synthetic samples, not population P95. Cold app, arbitrary uncached target, first hover hit rate and distinct-session long-run memory remain unmeasured.

exploratoryExclusions.reason: CPU profiling enabled; excluded from paired performance result.
Intermediate eager acquisition; repeated mounts still blocked delivery; not final code.
Unshipped eager 90-turn prefill; extra delay did not improve opening.
CPU profiling enabled; intermediate entry-tail change.
Three-sample exploration superseded by final ten-sample measurement; show/input medians 235.61/300.51 ms.
Probe-only native animation override; three-sample show/input medians 227.47/286.65 ms; not shipped.

residentMemory.scope: Electron app.getAppMetrics process set; external CLI/daemon processes excluded
residentMemory.metric: Sum of macOS footprint auxiliary.phys_footprint bytes; working sets retained separately

postMerge.construction: Merge main 8872177b6 into optimization commit 70a546588. Baseline restores the 13 product delta paths to fc6e52e9e, except view.tsx uses main 8872177b6 to preserve its StyleX and rhythm changes. The new navigator file is absent in baseline. Both builds retain shared ownership, the same merged-main UI elsewhere, dependencies and staged CLI. After then before; ten measured samples each, three warmups each; no concurrent tests/builds.

residentMemory.scope: Electron app.getAppMetrics process set; external CLI/daemon processes excluded
residentMemory.metric: Sum of macOS footprint auxiliary.phys_footprint bytes; working sets retained separately

ablation.method: Single-factor exploratory runs; each is relative to the same baseline, not cumulative. All use no-hover direct click, 3000 synthetic entries and the same staged CLI/dependencies; three warmups excluded. Composer pair uses one diagnostic build, no input measurement, and replaces the entire composer with its source-measured box only in the target. It is an omission upper bound, not reusable interactive UI.

validation.focused: 132 tests across four suites (including retained navigation handoff tests); 40 seeds × 60 operations at each of 400/800px
validation.browser: 4 cases on intermediate 400px, then all 4 again on retained 800px; initial 200px failed a 4px wheel-position assertion while 800px control passed. Original outline E2E assumed offscreen ticks remained mounted and was corrected to scroll first.
validation.modelOracle: The stored anchor, not the incidental top row after row-height clamping, owns the reading position. Seed 37 at 400px exposed that oracle mistake; the existing explicit eviction/rehydration case requires restoring the stored offset.
validation.memory: Not repeated: all product experiments reverted; no new resident surfaces/caches.
